supercharger_access.notes: Quick web lookup. Canadian article (Sept 2024) on the GM NACS adapter for Canadian owners of Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ. Says nothing about 2026 trim ports.

charge_port.notes: Estimated: GCN (GM 2027 NACS announcement) says most 2026 GM EVs keep CCS1 and need the GM NACS adapter, naming only the Optiq and Bolt as NACS-native for 2026; InsideEVs says the 2027 truck moves to native NACS. Model year 2026, US basis; Canadian truck assumed the same (Guide Auto 2024-09-18: GM adapter programme for Canadian Silverado EV owners).

wheels.notes: US Cars.com: Extended Range LT 18 x 8.5 in aluminum (applied to both charger trims).
